preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of edges m must be between n-1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the calculated variance of the number of connected components modulo 10^9+7.
